items.docs: Retrieve financial news articles with advanced filtering by tickers, sources, dates, countries, categories, and custom queries. Supports boolean query language with field filters. Returns paginated results with sentiment scores, entity tags, and article metadata.

params.name: link
params.description: The full URL of the article to retrieve

params.name: includeContent
params.description: Whether to include full article content in the response

params.name: includeEntities
params.description: Whether to include tagged company entity data

items.docs: Retrieve a single financial news article by its original URL. Returns full article metadata including sentiment analysis and company entity tags.
